newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Centennial to sell golf club shares.
newsitem.headline: Centennial to sell golf club shares.

text.p: Philippines' real estate developer Centennial City said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with a local financial consortium to sell golf club shares with an approximate gross value of 3.1 billion pesos.
The company identified the brokers as Asian Alliance Holdings and Development Corp, Crown Equities Inc and Urban Leisure and Development Corp.
The shares represent 70 percent of the golf club to be built by Centennial City and its subsidiary Amari Coastal Bay Development Corp along the Manila bay area.
